goal: Issue #414 slice S1 (Spec docs/specs/host-neutral-adapter-core.spec.md, D1, D2, D3, D4, D12, D13). ADR 0038 records the neutral layer plugins/immune-brain/runtime/host-core/ with dependency direction kernel <- assurance <- host-core <- adapters, and docs/reference/layering-rules.md names it. One HookEventLog (memory and file) and one private-file helper set in host-core serve the Claude Code and Antigravity adapters, which keep no copy. Antigravity --hook appends a start event for an allowed invoke_subagent PreToolUse. The boundary test refuses kernel/ or assurance/ imports of host-core. Verifier state machines, runtimes, the MCP runtime and run continuation are otherwise unchanged. No user-visible change: internal seam.

acceptance.assertion: Spec S1 AC1 (BR-REQ-1, BR-DEC-1; D1, D12). Done looks like: a maintainer finds the host-core layer, its dependency direction and its ADR from the layering reference. Seam: tests/layering-rules-contract.test.ts over the real files. Positive: docs/adr/0038-host-neutral-adapter-core.md exists and contains 'runtime/host-core'; the reference's Dependency Rule section contains 'plugins/immune-brain/runtime/host-core/' and links ADR 0038. Negative: the reference no longer contains 'four-edge' (the observed baseline has three edges) and its Enforcement section pins no edge count. Bound: the packaged copies under plugins/immune-brain/dist/docs/reference/ and plugins/immune-brain-antigravity/dist/docs/reference/ stay byte-equal.

Spec S1 AC2 (BR-REQ-1, BR-DEC-1; D1, D2). Done looks like: an import from the Kernel or the assurance layer into host-core fails the boundary test, and adapters may depend on host-core. Seam: tests/runtime-layering-boundary.test.ts, tests whose names contain 'host-core'. Positive: the real sources contain no runtime/kernel/ or runtime/assurance/ file importing a runtime/host-core/ module, and at least one runtime/claude/ and one runtime/antigravity/ file import runtime/host-core/. Negative (fixtures): runtime/assurance/x.ts importing '../host-core/y' and runtime/kernel/z.ts importing '../host-core/w' are both reported; runtime/host-core/a.ts importing '../claude/b' is reported by the inner-layer rule. Bound: runtime/claude/c.ts and runtime/antigravity/d.ts importing '../host-core/e' are reported by neither rule nor counted as host-to-host edges, and the three-entry BASELINE is unchanged.

Spec S1 AC3 (BR-REQ-2; D3). Done looks like: both Hosts' hook event logs and private-file helpers are one implementation with the Claude file behavior. Seam: tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts describe 'shared hook event log', parameterized over the file log each adapter constructs, each over an isolated temp root. Positive: two events appended for session 's1' and one for 's2' list in append order per session; sessions() returns the session ids 's1' and 's2', not file hashes; files land under <root>/immune-brain-claude and <root>/immune-brain-antigravity respectively; clear('s1') removes only s1's events. Negative: when <root>/<cache name> is a symlink to another directory, append returns false and nothing is written through the link, for both Hosts; a session file with mode 0644 lists no events. Bound: MemoryHookEventLog lists the same events as the file log for the same append and clear sequence. Structural: no file directly under runtime/claude/ or runtime/antigravity/ declares class FileHookEventLog, class MemoryHookEventLog, or a function named ensurePrivateDir, appendPrivate, readPrivate, sessionHash or ownedByUs.

Spec S1 AC4 (BR-REQ-8, BR-DEC-3; D4). Done looks like: real Antigravity hook dispatch records the verifier start and its result in the real event log. Seam: tests/antigravity-assurance-conformance.test.ts describe 'hook dispatch writes subagent events', spawning `bun plugins/immune-brain/runtime/antigravity/mcp_server.ts --hook` with TMPDIR set to a temp directory and the payload on stdin, then reading the adapter's file log over that root. Positive: PreToolUse {toolCall: {name: 'invoke_subagent', args: {TypeName: 'immune-brain-review-verifier', Prompt: 'p', Model: 'm'}}, stepIdx: 7, conversationId: 'c'} then PostToolUse with stepIdx 7 and result 'r' list for session 'c' as a start event (agent 'immune-brain-review-verifier', agentId '7', prompt 'p') followed by a result event (agentId '7', result 'r'); the PreToolUse stdout is {"decision":"allow"} as before; toolCall.name 'Subagent' behaves the same. Negative: a PreToolUse for 'edit_file', and an invoke_subagent PreToolUse without stepIdx, append nothing. Bound: a PostToolUse with no earlier PreToolUse is still appended as a result event.

scope_size_reason: The ADR, the layering reference and its boundary test must land with the first host-core code (ADR 0035 Decision 3, Spec D12); the new layer also needs its package.json files entry and two not-yet-derived Antigravity runtime copies, and the five importers of the moved helpers change only their import lines.
